import re

def unq(t):
    t = t.strip()
    if len(t) >= 2 and t[0] == '"' and t[-1] == '"':
        t = t[1:-1]
    return t

def parse(lines):
    kv_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<key>[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(?P<value>.*?)\s*$')
    recs = [{}]
    kvl = []
    rows = []
    tl = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)
    while i < n:
        s = lines[i]
        m = kv_re.match(s)
        if not m:
            i += 1
            continue
        k = m.group('key')
        v = m.group('value')
        if v == '(':
            tl.append(i)
            i += 1
            while i < n and lines[i].strip() != ')':
                t = lines[i].strip()
                if t:
                    if t.endswith(','):
                        t = t[:-1]
                    rows.append({'attribute': k, 'value': unq(t)})
                tl.append(i)
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                tl.append(i)
            i += 1
            continue
        if k in recs[-1]:
            recs.append({})
        recs[-1][k] = unq(v)
        kvl.append(i)
        i += 1
    blocks = []
    recs = [r for r in recs if r]
    if recs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'attributes', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kvl, 'records': recs})
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'list_attributes', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': tl, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}
